title: MemoryProviderStatus
description: The health/availability card for one memory/context provider behind a Baltor wrapper. A candidate provider (e.g. supermemory.api@candidate, mcp.supermemory@candidate) reports status='candidate' or 'unavailable' with a reason naming the missing credential — as an env:// REFERENCE, never a secret value. The deterministic emulator reports status='emulated', available=true with NO credential needed, so the golden path runs offline with zero credentials. credential_ref MUST be an env:// reference, never an inline key/value.

status.description: active = real provider wired; candidate = cataloged but not yet a runtime dependency; emulated = deterministic offline impl; unavailable = missing creds/reachability.

available.description: Whether the provider can currently serve. The emulator is available=true with no creds; a candidate with no creds is available=false.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation, e.g. 'missing credential env://SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY'. Never contains a secret value.

credential_ref.description: REFERENCE to the credential the provider needs, e.g. 'env://SUPERMEMORY_API_KEY'. MUST start with env:// or secret:// — NEVER an inline key value.
